metrics.method: Full history 2026-06-08 to 2026-08-26 (850 records, 464 client / 370 our-side incl. vendor / 16 service). client_questions_total = script count of Sarah Lloyd messages containing '?' or a request marker (please/pls/could you/could we/can we/can you/bumping/following up/lmk/let me know/would be great/any update/when will). unanswered_over_24h = hand-tallied asks with no on-topic reply within 24h; the script found only 3 with zero our-side output of any kind in 24h, hand review added 8 more where we posted but never addressed the ask, of which 3 were never answered at all (Jun 17 newer-content reminder, Aug 14 livestream promo MM, the Jun 13 / Aug 19 one-set-per-sexting-session request). max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive our-side messages; the second figure excludes Michelle/Mica/Stephski templated posts. Promises = hand-tallied explicit commitments by any ALTR or vendor member; kept = visible delivery or confirmation with no recurrence, lapsed = recurred or never delivered, unverifiable = no way to confirm from the chat. Latency figures are time from a client ask to the first subsequent our-side message of any kind, so they flatter us.
